pages.description: Give Support explains how to explore local providers and confirm their identity and current needs through official channels. Our Ground does not process donations, book volunteer opportunities, collect card details, or guarantee tax deductibility. Fictional demonstration listings are not real providers and cannot receive support.

pages.description: For Organizations explains how representatives can request access to their organization and location through their account. Administrators must approve organization access before assigned records can be edited; proposed updates require review. Eden can explain this public process but cannot sign in, inspect private accounts, or submit access requests or changes.
